issues.title: First world generation can stall for minutes
issues.workaround: Wait out the first load; recipe epoch expansion is already excluded (3034 ms). Capture a timestamped thread dump before changing worldgen or the recipe pipeline.

issues.title: Wrench toggles the whole clicked face instead of GT6 nine-grid sides
issues.workaround: Click the face whose connection should change. Overlay and UV nine-grid belong to 4.5, not the Beta gate.

issues.title: Wire cutters are missing; cables are set with a wrench
issues.workaround: Use a wrench on cables and wires. GT6 TOOL_cutter plus nine-grid is a 4.5 interaction patch.

issues.title: Creative-tab wires and cables are split across pages
issues.workaround: Search both the Wires and Cables tabs; pipes currently share the Cables tab.

issues.title: Surface pebbles (rockGt) are not generated
issues.workaround: Obtain cobble from vanilla stone or ore processing. Surface rocks are a 4.5 worldgen polish, not a T20 vein gap.

issues.title: EMI does not fold same-prefix items (ingots, dusts, cables)
issues.workaround: Search by exact material and form. Tag-namespace unification (P8) is a prerequisite.

issues.title: Creative tab and EMI omit most registered tool material variants
issues.workaround: Craft tools in the assembler; recipes exist. Creative/EMI enumeration is display-only.

issues.title: Creative tab omits 18 registered higher-tier processing machines
issues.workaround: Craft the steel/titanium/invar variants from recipes or EMI; they are registered and craftable.

issues.title: Most material-form tags stay in cruciblecraft: instead of c:
issues.workaround: Use cruciblecraft:small_dusts, cruciblecraft:cables and similar tags until 4.5 backfills c:.

issues.title: Creative inventory has almost no filled fluid cells or buckets
issues.workaround: Produce fluids in machines on the survival path. Empty fluid_cell / gas_cell still exist.
